import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/work')
from solution import page
import copy
data=[{'id':9,'score':20},{'id':1,'score':10},{'id':3,'score':20},{'id':2,'score':5}]
before=copy.deepcopy(data)
a,c=page(data,limit=2)
assert [r['id'] for r in a]==[3,9] and c==(20,9)
b,d=page(data,c,2)
assert [r['id'] for r in b]==[1,2] and d is None
a,c=page(data,(15,100),1)
assert [r['id'] for r in a]==[1] and c==(10,1)
assert page([],limit=2)==([],None)
assert data==before
for n in [0,-1]:
    try: page(data,limit=n)
    except ValueError: pass
    else: raise AssertionError('limit')
